# ezkey

> A macOS menu bar extra for the login Keychain. Local only. No account, no server, no warranty.

## Home

ezkey is a small macOS extra for the login Keychain you already have. No account. No server. No warranty.

Name is Keychain Access Name and Where. Account is your Mac user and stays hidden. Retrieve: type part of a name, then pick. Secrets stay masked until Reveal. Copy clears in 30 seconds if unchanged.

Install: ask your agent to follow https://ezkey.app/.well-known/agent-skills/build-ezkey/SKILL.md. It shows the disclaimer, clones the newest release tag, reviews the code, and runs `./scripts/install.sh` only after you say go. By hand:

```
git clone --depth 1 --branch <tag> https://github.com/edtadros/ezkey.git
cd ezkey
./scripts/install.sh
```

Replace `<tag>` with the newest `v*` release tag. That copies the app to `/Applications/ezkey.app`, opens it, and turns on Open at Login. Requires macOS 14+ and Xcode command-line tools. There is no prebuilt app and no ezkey CLI. A local build is ad-hoc signed and not notarized. It does not need to be: it was never downloaded, so Gatekeeper does not check it.

## Privacy

ezkey does not include analytics, crash reporters, advertising, accounts, or network calls. Secret values are stored only in the macOS login Keychain. The website is static files on Cloudflare with no cookies or third-party scripts.

## Security

macOS still owns the Keychain. When ezkey reads an item another program created, macOS may ask for the login Keychain password. Always Allow is a standing grant to the code signature of the build you compiled. Each rebuild changes that signature, so macOS may ask again after an update.

Report vulnerabilities privately: https://github.com/edtadros/ezkey/security/advisories/new

## About

ezkey is a local macOS menu bar extra for the login Keychain. It is not a hosted password manager, browser extension, or sync service. Source is public. Build it on your Mac.

## Contact

No support desk. Security: https://github.com/edtadros/ezkey/security/advisories/new. Other issues: https://github.com/edtadros/ezkey

## Developers

Public REST at https://ezkey.app/api/v1 (health, overview, build, pages). MCP at /mcp. A2A at /a2a. No authentication. OpenAPI: https://ezkey.app/openapi.json

## Glossary

- Name: Keychain Access Name. ezkey stores the same string as Where (service).
- Account: Keychain account attribute. ezkey always uses the logged-in Mac username.
- Where: Keychain Access field for the generic-password service (`security -s`).
- login Keychain: `~/Library/Keychains/login.keychain-db`
